dataset: Medicare Part D Prescribers - by Provider and Drug

fields.description: Calendar year of the data (added during processing; not in original CMS file).
fields.cms_definition: Derived from the annual file name / release year.

fields.description: National Provider Identifier — unique 10-digit ID for the prescribing provider.
fields.cms_definition: National Provider Identifier for the performing provider on the Part D claim.

fields.description: Provider specialty (e.g. Internal Medicine, Endocrinology, Family Practice).
fields.cms_definition: Derived from Medicare claims or NPPES taxonomy mapping when claims-based specialty is not available.

fields.description: U.S. state abbreviation of the provider's practice location.
fields.cms_definition: The state where the provider is located, as reported in NPPES.

fields.description: Brand (trade) name of the drug as it appears on the claim.
fields.cms_definition: The trade name under which the drug is sold.

fields.description: Generic (active ingredient) name of the drug.
fields.cms_definition: Chemical ingredient name of the drug product.

fields.description: Total number of Medicare Part D claims including original prescriptions and refills.
fields.cms_definition: Number of Medicare Part D claims, including original prescriptions and refills. Suppressed where < 11.
fields.suppression_note: Blank/null values may represent CMS suppression (< 11 claims). Do NOT replace with zero.

fields.description: Standardized 30-day fill count. Normalizes prescriptions of varying day-supply to a common 30-day unit.
fields.cms_definition: Total standardized 30-day fills. Calculated by dividing total day supply by 30.
fields.suppression_note: Subject to same suppression rules as Tot_Clms.

fields.description: Aggregate drug cost for this provider–drug combination in the given year.
fields.cms_definition: Aggregate cost paid for all associated claims including ingredient cost, dispensing fee, sales tax, and any applicable vaccine administration fees.
fields.suppression_note: Subject to same suppression rules as Tot_Clms.

fields.description: Total days supply for all claims of this drug by this provider.
fields.cms_definition: Aggregate number of day's supply for all claims.
fields.suppression_note: Subject to same suppression rules as Tot_Clms.

fields.description: Total number of unique Medicare Part D beneficiaries who received this drug from this provider.
fields.cms_definition: Total number of unique Medicare Part D beneficiaries with at least one claim. Suppressed where < 11.
fields.suppression_note: Subject to same suppression rules as Tot_Clms.

suppression_policy.description: CMS suppresses data when the number of claims or beneficiaries is fewer than 11 to protect patient privacy.
suppression_policy.handling: Suppressed values are stored as NULL/NaN. A boolean 'is_suppressed' flag is created during cleaning. These records are NEVER replaced with zero as that would bias the analysis.

key_relationships.drug_dimension: Brand/Generic → RxCUI → Ingredient → Therapeutic Class → Diabetes Category
